svg.text: OBJ-201 Planter, plant stand, disc base and two plates
Approved by Sabry 25 Nov 2026. Production review pending. Not engineered
معتمد من سبري ٢٥ نوفمبر ٢٠٢٦، بانتظار مراجعة التصنيع، غير مهندس
SECTIONS A-A, B-B, C-C (cut planes are marked on sheet 2; cut material is black or hatched)
at height 200: through the plates below the shelf
at height 340: through the window; leg strips and spacers
at height 279: through the shelf flanges
Plates are cut black (2 mm). Hatched area on C-C is the shelf flange metal. Below the cut plane the base flanges are seen in light grey.
Dashed: pot stand-in (not ours). The spacers on B-B are Ø10 tubes, 22 long, between the two plates; fixing by Production.
